name: 01566 · Sturbridge, MA
findings: ZIP 01566 (Sturbridge) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01566 (Sturbridge) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
